target: relation between action-response spectrum and absorption spectrum (optical_action_spectra.tsv)
discrepancies: Best single-scale s: reported 94.2; through-origin LSQ on all six points gives s=90.2185.
The reported RMSE 8.872 / R2 0.92255 are only reproduced by s=90.2185, not by s=94.2 (s=94.2 gives RMSE 9.2812, R2 0.91524) - reported s and reported RMSE/R2 are mutually inconsistent.
s=94.2338 is instead the through-origin slope fitted on the <=500 nm subset only (the holdout fit); it was evidently reported as the full-range s.
agreements: Absorption values at all six action wavelengths match exactly (0.887, 0.861, 0.85, 0.585, 0.364, 0.201); exact 0.5 nm grid lookup, no interpolation needed.
All 15 probe/ref pairs computed; the 65-> pairs vary 0.218-0.237, far below 1, indicating action/absorption mismatch.
Holdout fit on <=500 nm: s=94.2338, predicted action at 650 nm = 18.941 vs observed 4.2 (relative error +351%).
method_notes: Absorption values taken by exact nearest-grid lookup (wavelengths coincide exactly with the 0.5 nm grid; asserted unique match). Ratio statistic R = (action_probe/action_ref)/(abs_probe/abs_ref) for all 30 ordered pairs (15 unordered). Single-scale fit action ~ s*absorption fitted through the origin by ordinary least squares s = sum(A*y)/sum(A^2) on all six action points. R2 computed as 1 - SSE/SST against the 6-point mean. Holdout: s refit through origin on the three points with lambda<=500 nm, then applied to 550/600/650 nm; relative error = (pred-obs)/obs*100. Note: one curve in each modality, so the 6 points of each are one trajectory (wavelengths are not independent replicates); only 6 action points, so fit statistics are low-power. Runtime negligible.
